credentialEnvironment.ASC_KEY_PATH: Path to the downloaded AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8 private key.

submissionFieldGroups.resource: App Store Connect API credentials and RevenueCat MCP authentication
automatableFields: App Store Connect JWT/API key readiness
submissionFieldGroups.notes: Run before applying App Store Connect metadata, subscription pricing, screenshots, build uploads, review submissions, or RevenueCat products/entitlements/offerings/paywalls. If either service fails, Codex should prompt the user to re-authorize that service before continuing.
The public API can manage existing app records. Create brand-new app records in App Store Connect when the API does not expose the exact setup needed for the account.
Values must honestly reflect app content. Do not lower a rating for marketing reasons.

limits.keywords: 100 characters maximum, comma-separated, no spaces after commas

submissionFieldGroups.notes: What's New/version history should use hyphen-prefixed bullet lines, one user-visible change per line. Codex normalizes flat paragraphs before applying version localizations. Initial app or platform releases can set initialPlatformRelease to true when App Store Connect does not expose editable What's New text yet.
Apple may scale highest-resolution screenshots down for smaller sizes when the UI is the same across device sizes.

If the Build Uploads API rejects checksum metadata or Transporter is unavailable, use Xcode's archive export upload fallback, then poll builds until the uploaded build is processed/VALID and PATCH appStoreVersions with version.buildId. Ready for submission means the uploaded build is processed and selected in App Store Connect, not merely archived locally.

submissionFieldGroups.group: Apple universal purchase and macOS platform sync
submissionFieldGroups.resource: App Store Connect app record, platform versions, in-app purchases, and RevenueCat project mapping
automatableFields: same App Store app record declaration
shared Apple subscription product catalog declaration
separate platform product mapping when not universal purchase
submissionFieldGroups.notes: For Apple universal purchase, add macOS as another platform version under the same app record and keep equivalent subscriptions in the shared app product catalog. RevenueCat should use one project, the same entitlement, and the same offering/paywall for a consistent iOS/macOS experience. If the Mac app is a separate app record or legacy Mac configuration, use platform-specific Apple product IDs but map them into equivalent RevenueCat packages that unlock the same entitlement.

submissionFieldGroups.resource: Xcode project files and submission config
submissionFieldGroups.notes: The plugin can infer version/build values from project files, git history, and optional Codex iteration counts. It dry-runs by default and updates local project files only after explicit confirmation.

submissionFieldGroups.safety: The plugin requires explicit confirmation before submitting to review.

submissionFieldGroups.resource: inAppPurchases, subscriptions, localizations, prices, review screenshots, submissions
automatableFields: macOS desktop review screenshot shape checks
submissionFieldGroups.notes: First-time IAPs and subscriptions are commonly submitted with a new app version. Apple's public subscription submission API can reject the first-time case with FIRST_SUBSCRIPTION_MUST_BE_SUBMITTED_ON_VERSION, so the products may need to be selected in appstoreconnect.apple.com with the uploaded app-version build before review submission. The plugin validates selected-build, UI-selection evidence, subscription product/localization status, subscription availability, and subscription review screenshot readback before calling a release ready. Screenshot copy should make paid or subscription-only features unmistakable. For weekly/monthly/yearly paywalls, each product should have a visible processed App Review screenshot with the matching plan selected unless a shared screenshot is intentionally documented. For macOS submissions, subscription App Review screenshots must show desktop-shaped Mac app evidence, not phone-sized portrait paywalls. Subscription product prices and introductory offers are separate from product availability; verify subscriptionAvailabilities independently. Subscription product prices are separate from app download price. Pricing research should be refreshed every six months; weekly $4.99, monthly $9.99, and yearly $29.99 are the default plan prices, each with a 14-day free trial unless the builder records an override. Yearly should be a real best-value anchor, and weekly should reflect short-horizon or event-driven intent.

submissionFieldGroups.resource: Local app implementation guidance and submission config validation
automatableFields: creator override rationale for custom subscription access
No payment due now paywall tagline
submissionFieldGroups.notes: The plugin defaults subscription apps to Free + Pro: roughly 70-80% of useful functionality remains free, while Pro unlocks high-intent depth such as unlimited usage, advanced alerts, widgets, history, exports, insights, or premium personalization. Default paywalls use Start 14-day free trial plus a check-mark No payment due now tagline only when StoreKit/RevenueCat confirms a real free trial. Creators can override the split or trial with an explicit rationale. Apple controls whether the system rating prompt is displayed; the plugin validates trigger policy so requestReview is used after positive non-interruptive outcomes, not launch, onboarding, paywall, purchase, cancellation, or error flows.

copyBestPractices.name: Use the clearest searchable brand/category phrase without stuffing.
copyBestPractices.subtitle: State the concrete user outcome in 30 characters or fewer.
copyBestPractices.description: Lead with the strongest benefit in the first sentence, then use concise feature bullets. Avoid prices and keyword stuffing.
copyBestPractices.keywords: Use relevant comma-separated terms, avoid duplicates, category names, competitor names, trademarks, offensive terms, and spaces after commas.
copyBestPractices.promotionalText: Use for current news or offers, not search ranking keywords.
copyBestPractices.screenshots: Make the first one to three images explain the app's core value with a big bold headline, colorful background, and visible neutral CTA. Use one benefit per screenshot. Show the base product as genuinely useful, mark subscription or paid-only features clearly, and avoid price/free/trial/discount/no-payment wording in public screenshot overlays.
copyBestPractices.customProductPages: Match screenshots, promo text, and keywords to a specific ad group, audience, feature, or seasonal intent.
